OpenAI — API access

openai/api · version 1

envs add openai/api

This declares the keys below in your catalog and sets none of them. A template is a schema for keys; it never carries a value.

Key Needed Kind Notes
OPENAI_API_KEY required secret Billed per call. Never reaches the browser.. Shape ^sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$. Rotate every 180 days. where to get it
OPENAI_ORG_ID optional config Only needed when an account has more than one org.. Shape ^org-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}$. where to get it
